# Aktiechefens nya case – efter starkt facit

**Feed**: dagen-med-di  
**Published**: 2026-08-14  
**Market Sentiment**: Positive

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

The episode reviews the host analyst's (Carl's) prior stock recommendations, which performed strongly since March 20 (Sobi +25%, Atlas Copco +33%, Evolution +27%), and introduces a new case in Nordnet. The market view is broadly constructive, driven by buoyant equity markets, all-time-high US indices, and renewed tech interest, with Nordnet positioned as a long-term structural winner on rising customer savings capital and potential German expansion. Overall tone is optimistic though nuanced on short-term potential after strong runs.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 EVO — Evolution | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 70%

Mest lockande av trion även på kort sikt; lågt budpliktsbud minskar säljtryck, återköpsprogram får bättre effekt.

#### Reasoning

Host views Evolution as the most attractive of Sobi/Atlas/Evolution from current levels, with good potential even short-term. Kenneth Dart's low mandatory bid removes selling pressure and lets the buyback program work more effectively; continued upside seen from here despite the 27% run since March.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Kenneth Dart sells his large stake into the market
- if share price rises enough to make Dart a seller

> *"Då tycker jag nog att Evolution är den som fortfarande känns mest lockad från de här nivåerna. Där tycker jag nog att potentialen även i ett kortare perspektiv fortfarande ser god ut."*

---

### 🟡 ATCO-A — Atlas Copco | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Jätteintressant att äga långsiktigt men mindre kortsiktig potential efter 33% uppgång; aktiva investerare kan ta vinster på rekyl.

#### Reasoning

Host still considers Atlas Copco a very interesting long-term holding as the business is picking up, but after the strong 33% run there is less short-term upside. Active traders may take short-term profits and buy back on a pullback, while long-term holders keep it.

#### Sell Triggers

- if short-term rally overextends valuation
- if business recovery stalls

> *"Jag tycker fortfarande det är ett jätteintressant bolag att äga långsiktigt. Men givet den här starka kursutvecklingen så kanske det inte riktigt blir fullt lika mycket potential i ett kortare perspektiv."*

---

### 🟢 SAVE — Nordnet | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Långsiktigt case: räntenetto, valutaväxling på utländska aktier, växande sparkapital driver vinster; optionalitet i tysk expansion.

#### Reasoning

Host's new case. Net brokers share qualities with big banks via steady net interest income; buoyant equity markets and interest in foreign/US tech stocks drive FX revenue. Main long-term driver is growing customer savings capital lifting profits, with added optionality from German expansion potentially doubling the market.

#### Sell Triggers

- if German expansion fails to gain traction
- if equity market interest and inflows decline
- if savings capital growth stalls

> *"Men sen är det egentligen mer som ett långsiktigt case som jag tycker är riktigt intressant för att över tid så kommer vi se att sparkapitalet som de har hos sina kunder kommer öka och det är egentligen det som är den stora drivaren för att vinsterna kommer öka över tid."*

---

### 🟡 SOBI — Sobi | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Tidigare rek upp nästan 25%; nämns positivt som del av stark trio men utan explicit ny köprekommendation.

#### Reasoning

Sobi is cited as a past recommendation that gained nearly 25%, grouped positively with Atlas and Evolution. When asked which of the trio is most attractive now the host picks Evolution, implying Sobi is a continued hold rather than a fresh buy at current levels.

#### Sell Triggers

- if momentum fades after the strong run

> *"Vi hann avhandla Sobi i alla fall. Ja, precis. De var upp nästan 25 %."*

---
